headlines.title: Is Shopify (SHOP) Becoming A Real Gateway For AI Driven Commerce?
headlines.summary: Shopify (NasdaqGS:SHOP) merchants have started adopting DeepLumen's Agentic Page app as a new AI-powered sales channel on the platform. DeepLumen reports that nearly 2,000 Shopify stores now use Agentic Page to support AI-based product discovery and ordering by external agents. The Agentic Page integration enables third-party AI agents to attribute orders back to specific Shopify merchants through a dedicated tracking layer.

headlines.title: Would You Have Held Shopify Through an 86.6% Crash? Here’s What Happened Next
headlines.summary: Shopify turned a $1,000 bet into a life-changing fortune over ten years, but the path ran straight through a collapse that sent most investors sprinting for the exit. Whether today's entry point repeats that story or ends differently depends on a few critical variables.

headlines.title: eBay Jumps 5% on Takeover Speculation; Etsy Rallies 7%, Shopify Holds Flat
headlines.summary: Unconfirmed takeover chatter linking two unlikely names sent one e-commerce stock surging far beyond its peers, while a fresh analyst endorsement already waiting in the wings raises the question of whether fundamentals or rumors are doing the real work.

headlines.title: Shopify Marketing Agency Advisory: October API Update Changes How Shipping, Inventory and Order Apps Work
headlines.summary: Shopify’s 2026-10 API version, stable since Oct. 1, removes the incomplete-checkout field from the Customer Account API, and the Admin API now returns errors for metafield filters it cannot apply.*Newly registered carrier services no longer add rates to Shopify’s General shipping profile, and shipping-address changes made through the Admin API on unfulfilled orders now recalculate taxes.

headlines.title: SHOP Stock Heads For 4th Green Week: Analysts See Up To 10% Upside For Shopify Ahead Of Earnings
headlines.summary: Jefferies sees gross merchandise volume upside, and Baird raises its price target on Shopify to $190.

description: Shopify Inc., a commerce technology company, provides tools to start, scale, market, and run a business of various sizes in Canada, the United States, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, the Asia Pacific, and Latin America. The Company offers Shopify platform that enables merchants to manage products and inventory, process orders and payments, fulfill and ship orders, build customer relationships, source products, leverage analytics, and reporting and access financing for running their business across all of their sales channels, including web and mobile storefronts, physical retail locations, social media storefronts, and marketplaces. It also provides Shopify Payments, a fully integrated payment processing service that allows merchants to accept and process payment cards online and offline. In addition, the company engages in the sale of themes and apps; shipping labels through Shopify Shipping; point-of-sale hardware; advertising on the Shopify App Store; and Shop Campaigns for buyer acquisitions, as well as registration of domain names. The company was formerly known as Jaded Pixel Technologies Inc. and changed its name to Shopify Inc. in November 2011. Shopify Inc. was incorporated in 2004 and is based in Ottawa, Canada.
